commit.title: Add samples for formats and tools the suite didn't cover
commit.message:
Add samples for formats and tools the suite didn't cover

Twelve small samples (19 KB in total) for 4:2:2, 4:4:4, 12-bit, still
pictures, resizing, 256x256 superblocks, tile rows and film grain at
high bitdepth. The suite so far had only 4:2:0 at 8 and 10 bits.

The 4:2:2 12-bit sample uses 64x64 chroma restoration units with
128x128 superblocks, so two units per superblock. avmenc rarely picks
that: 4 of 11900 random-config streams had it, all 4:2:2.

They were picked by edge coverage of a C-only dav2d build
(-fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard, main b130414d): from about 3800
random-config streams that decode correctly, a greedy pass took the
smallest streams adding the most edges not reached by the existing
samples. Together they raise the edges reached from 9434 to 11019 of
19423. Each one matches avmdec on main b130414d with and without asm,
with 4 frame threads, and with ASan+UBSan (C and asm).

The 10/12-bit samples go in avm-10bit, which now also passes
--filmgrain=1 like avm does.

  ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=130x74:r=30 -frames:v 24 -pix_fmt yuv420p10le|yuv422p10le -strict -1

commit.title: Add samples for formats and tools the suite didn't cover
commit.message:
Add samples for formats and tools the suite didn't cover

Twelve small samples (19 KB in total) for 4:2:2, 4:4:4, 12-bit, still
pictures, resizing, 256x256 superblocks, tile rows and film grain at
high bitdepth. The suite so far had only 4:2:0 at 8 and 10 bits.

The 4:2:2 12-bit sample uses 64x64 chroma restoration units with
128x128 superblocks, so two units per superblock. avmenc rarely picks
that: 4 of 11900 random-config streams had it, all 4:2:2.

They were picked by edge coverage of a C-only dav2d build
(-fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard, main b130414d): from about 3800
random-config streams that decode correctly, a greedy pass took the
smallest streams adding the most edges not reached by the existing
samples. Together they raise the edges reached from 9434 to 11019 of
19423. Each one matches avmdec on main b130414d with and without asm,
with 4 frame threads, and with ASan+UBSan (C and asm).

The 10/12-bit samples go in avm-10bit, which now also passes
--filmgrain=1 like avm does.
